title: Deep learning separates autoimmune hepatitis from primary biliary cholangitis on biopsies
summary: The ALNE transformer-based model was trained without human annotations on 354 cases (266 AIH, 102 PBC) and reached AUC 0.81 in external validation of 92 cases (62 AIH, 30 PBC) from European centers. Attention heatmaps focused on inflamed areas, and agreement among general pathologists was low (Fleiss kappa 0.09). The study is retrospective and the external set is small.
ai_technology: Transformer-based deep-learning model on H&E whole-slide images

evidence.tested: External validation against clinico-pathological diagnoses and interobserver agreement testing.
evidence.unknown: AUC is modest and prospective performance is not tested. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ALNE learned slide-level differences between AIH and PBC without annotations.
